about: Renders a multi-line text field that keeps the height of its rows or grows with its text.
answer: Thanks for the photos. The refund is on its way.

grip.about: The resize handle drags nowhere, down, or both ways. Each value sets the CSS `resize` property.
grip.title: Grip

grows.about: Both fields contain more lines than their three rows. Without `grows` the field keeps its rows and scrolls. With `grows` it takes the height of its text.
grows.title: Grows

prompt: Add a note for the courier

size.about: Every size in every look. The text reads the body role, and the inset is one size smaller than the size, the same as the input's.
size.title: Sizes and looks

states.about: Rest, keyboard focus, disabled, read-only and invalid in every look. The subtle and flushed looks report focus by widening their edge to 2px in the ring color. A read-only field dashes its edges.
states.title: States

status.about: Every status in every look. A status sets the edge and the focus ring from its palette.
status.title: Statuses
